description: This file defines hotkey management for the Wesnoth game, including hotkey list initialization, loading/saving hotkeys, handling key events, and executing commands associated with hotkeys.
external_methods: get_hotkey(int, bool, bool, bool, bool, bool)

classes.name: hotkey::hotkey_item
classes.description: Represents a hotkey with associated command, description, keycode, modifiers, and visibility.

classes.name: hotkey::manager
classes.description: Manages the list of hotkeys, including initialization, loading, saving, and retrieval.

classes.name: hotkey::basic_handler
classes.description: Handles SDL events related to hotkeys, dispatching key events to command execution.

classes.name: hotkey::command_executor
classes.description: Interface for executing commands triggered by hotkeys, including UI actions and game commands.

methods.name: hotkey::hotkey_item::load_from_config
methods.description: Loads hotkey configuration from a config object, setting keycode and modifiers.

methods.name: hotkey::hotkey_item::get_name
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the hotkey with modifiers.

methods.name: hotkey::hotkey_item::set_description
methods.description: Sets the description for the hotkey.

methods.name: hotkey::hotkey_item::set_key
methods.description: Sets the keycode and modifiers for the hotkey.

methods.name: hotkey::manager::manager
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the hotkey list from predefined list.

methods.name: hotkey::manager::~manager
methods.description: Destructor that clears the hotkey list.

methods.name: hotkey::load_descriptions
methods.description: Loads descriptions for all hotkeys from localization.

methods.name: hotkey::load_hotkeys
methods.description: Loads hotkey configurations from a config object.

methods.name: hotkey::save_hotkeys
methods.description: Saves current hotkey configurations to a config object.

methods.name: hotkey::get_hotkey
methods.description: Retrieves a hotkey by command ID, command string, or key combination.

methods.name: hotkey::get_hotkey
methods.description: Retrieves a hotkey matching a SDL keyboard event.

methods.name: hotkey::get_visible_hotkey
methods.description: Retrieves a visible hotkey by index.

methods.name: hotkey::get_hotkeys
methods.description: Returns the list of all hotkeys.

methods.name: hotkey::basic_handler::basic_handler
methods.description: Constructor for event handler with display and command executor.

methods.name: hotkey::basic_handler::handle_event
methods.description: Handles SDL keydown events, dispatching to key_event or key_event_execute.

methods.name: hotkey::key_event
methods.description: Handles special key events like ESC to quit, then calls key_event_execute.

methods.name: hotkey::key_event_execute
methods.description: Executes the command associated with a hotkey based on SDL event.

methods.name: hotkey::execute_command
methods.description: Performs the action associated with a hotkey command, calling methods on display or executor.

methods.name: hotkey::command_executor::get_menu_image
methods.description: Returns the menu image for a command based on its state.
